pass_condition: Stable DOI plus table/figure/SI/path plus row/sample/snapshot id identifies the exact Srivastava/OI source row used by the witness payload.
block_condition: Missing source_row_id or source_row_id not resolvable to an auditable Srivastava/OI source row blocks all A-side OI/Srivastava gates.

pass_condition: structure_id is present and maps source_row_id to the exact atomistic structure, SI structure, or declared reconstruction version used for OI computation.
block_condition: Missing structure_id or structure_id not traceable to source_row_id blocks Srivastava reproduction and OI mode claims.

pass_condition: Value is exactly one of no_claim, fixed_density, fixed_pair, or srivastava_reproduction, and the mode is declared before any derived OI comparison is evaluated.
block_condition: Missing value, unsupported value, or mode changed after looking at target label blocks the row; no_claim remains context-only and cannot pass material validation.

pass_condition: Numeric raw overlap sum is supplied with source_row_id, structure_id, pair selection rule, and reproducible extraction or computation provenance.
block_condition: Missing OI_raw_sum blocks Srivastava reproduction, fixed_density, and fixed_pair gates even if OI_norm is reported.

pass_condition: Numeric OI_norm is supplied with explicit units/convention and is either reproduced from OI_raw_sum or marked reported_context_only.
block_condition: Missing OI_norm blocks baseline context; reported OI_norm without raw-sum derivation remains not reproduced.

pass_condition: Formula id points to an auditable equation/SI/table note defining normalization from OI_raw_sum to OI_norm for the same source_row_id.
block_condition: Missing formula id, ambiguous normalization, or formula not tied to the source row blocks Srivastava reproduction.

pass_condition: Numeric pair cutoff in Angstrom is supplied or an exact source-defined pair-selection rule is referenced by formula/procedure id.
block_condition: Missing cutoff or pair-selection rule blocks OI_raw_sum reproducibility and all fixed-density/fixed-pair comparisons.

pass_condition: Numeric pair_density is supplied with units and provenance, and is derived from the same structure_id and pair selection rule as OI_raw_sum.
block_condition: Missing pair_density blocks fixed_density mode; pair_density from a different structure or cutoff blocks the row.

pass_condition: Required when OI_comparison_mode=fixed_pair; equals OI_raw_sum/N_pair within declared tolerance and shares source_row_id and structure_id provenance.
block_condition: Missing OI_pair_mean in fixed_pair mode or mismatch with OI_raw_sum/N_pair blocks fixed_pair mode.

pass_condition: Required when OI_comparison_mode=fixed_pair; positive integer counted-pair denominator from the same structure_id and pair selection rule.
block_condition: Missing, nonpositive, noninteger, or cross-structure N_pair blocks fixed_pair mode.

pass_condition: Required when OI_comparison_mode=fixed_pair; identifies the source or computation record proving N_pair for the same source_row_id, structure_id, and pair cutoff.
block_condition: Missing denominator provenance blocks fixed_pair mode even if N_pair is numeric.
